verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere has user accounts and a hosted console playground that "keeps your recent conversations," so data export and leaving is a fair question for this product. The pack documents no data-export feature, open export format, or account-deletion path. On-device execution and the OpenAI-compatible endpoint concern where inference runs and API portability, not exporting a user's stored data, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
